networks.name: campus_desk
networks.description: Timetable, notices, fee dates and exam dates for the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (fictional sample department).
sample_queries: What classes do I have today?
When is the tuition fee due, and what is the late fee?
When is the Operating Systems exam?
Is the library open late during exams?
Can you pay my fees for me?

peer_policy.note: Calls only the sites in allowed_peers, and only after the visitor agrees on a card.

agent_mcp.reason: The agent network runs in the caller’s browser, so there is no hosted front-agent endpoint. The live site actions are offered over MCP at /api/mcp (see actions.remote) to agents the student has approved.

private_context.note: Year, section and fee category are private context (sly_data). They never leave for another site: the front agent names no fields.

catalog.name: get_timetable
catalog.purpose: Read the class timetable for one day, including cancelled or moved classes. Uses the student's saved class unless a year and section are given.

day.description: today, tomorrow, a weekday name such as Friday, or a date like 2026-11-18. Default is today.

year.description: Only when asking about another year.

section.description: Only when asking about another section.

catalog.name: get_next_class
catalog.purpose: Find the student's next class after the site clock, skipping cancelled ones.

catalog.name: search_notices
catalog.purpose: Search the department notices, newest first, for the student's year.

query.description: Words to look for. Leave empty for the latest notices.

catalog.name: get_fee_dates
catalog.purpose: Read fee due dates, amounts for the student's fee category, and late fees.

item.description: Part of a fee name, such as exam or tuition.

catalog.name: get_exam_dates
catalog.purpose: Read exam dates, times and venues for the student's year.

course.description: A course code such as CS201 or part of a course name.

catalog.name: save_reminder
catalog.purpose: Save a reminder for the student. The student must confirm it first.

remote.note: Optional extension beyond the minimum profile. An outside agent can ask a student for a grant and then call the live site actions. Every call is checked and written to the student’s signed ledger.
remote.auth: bearer grant token, signed Ed25519, scoped, expiring, bound to the caller origin

actions.note: Site actions run on this origin and are bound to agents here, so the network file stays plain agent data. A site that runs this network in its own browser gets the published snapshot, or it can ask the student for a grant to call the live actions.
